exposure: duration of the passive second stage of labour
duration of the passive second stage  0 to 119 min (0 to <2 h)
duration of the passive second stage 120-239 min (2- <4h)
duration of the passive second stage ≥240 min (≥4h)
cohort: 1131 nulliparous women at two delivery units in Sweden
finding: A longer duration of the passive second stage of labor was associated with an increased risk of operative delivery, particularly cesarean section, but not with adverse maternal outcomes, although there were indications of increased neonatal risks.
mod_finding: A passive second stage duration of ≥4 hours was associated with a nine-times increased risk of caesarean section and a four-times risk of instrumental delivery compared to a duration of <2 hours.
